verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a developer framework of primitives (agents, tools, handoffs, runners) for building your own agents. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to. Handoffs, where one agent delegates to another, are developer building blocks rather than a shipped in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
